dict.string: Your synth works with files on the Desktop only if you shared that folder in SNTH Connect.
Your synth works with files in Downloads only if you shared that folder in SNTH Connect.
Your synth works with files in Documents only if you shared a folder there in SNTH Connect.
Your synth works with files on this disk only if you shared a folder on it in SNTH Connect.
Your synth works with files on this network disk only if you shared a folder on it in SNTH Connect.
Your synth works with this app (for example your calendar, notes or messages) only if you switched that app on in SNTH Connect, under Apps.
SNTH Connect listens only while you hold the island's talk key, and sends what you said to your synth as a voice message.
SNTH Connect reads the name of your Wi-Fi network only to tell which of the places you named you are at. The network's name and your location stay on this computer.

Your synth reaches devices on your home network only if you turned that on in SNTH Connect.
